answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the nebula graph and each risks its bond. Because the zephyr release is logged with every signature, the beacon audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 17 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
